scope: New-task main-entry executable-launch attribution and explicit incremental-build control; common repeated check cost included

method.workload: New calc(x)=3*x-2 repair checked at3 and9,12M rotate/xor; every tool runs actual check twice with matching status; second stdout discarded, both executions charged
method.controls: Always compile versus fixed incremental recipe; delete check at trial reset; step0 compile, step1 source correction/rebuild, incremental step2 reuses artifact but still runs both tests
method.launch: Child main/compute-end MONOTONIC_RAW plus driver spawn start/return and wait4 end; pre-main includes launch and is not added to it; no assumption spawn return precedes main on every scheduler
method.calibration: Three complete tasks per state; independent per-mode past-only EWMA; no evaluation tuning
method.order: Rotate modes by replicate; same paired task counts and work; no best-run selection
method.costs: Save/tools/repair/final suffix/metrics parsing/cleanup and repeated checks included; initial history/load/calibration/oracle separately recorded

limits: First new-artifact execution delay is located by timestamps, not attributed to a specific macOS security service or kernel mechanism
Incremental compilation is an explicit benchmark/deployment recipe, not automatic Agent tool-result caching; tests are never skipped
No per-process resource probes during measured wrapper; child wait4 metrics and private numeric labels are common overhead
E24 missing child-entry boundaries cannot be retrospectively assigned to this new measurement; old negative remains
One M5/Metal/model, warm system, scripted actual tools; no physical KV shrinking, Windows/CUDA or autonomous-model claim

sanitizers.scope: New main/compute timing boundaries, same-artifact double execution/status agreement, actual source correction rebuild and unchanged-source reuse; full tool-host correctness/cancellation; cxf/adapters instrumented, upstream prebuilt excluded

unchanged_runtime_regression.scope: Production source hashes unchanged from E25 Native14K/KV/Stream/default/CLI once acceptance; not a claim those extra suites reran in E26
